verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm that Cursor serves a structured llms.txt at cursor.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, markdown index of docs). They also confirm a Bugbot-specific markdown docs page at cursor.com/docs/bugbot.md, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs for this product. Missing for 10: confirmation that the truncated llms.txt index actually lists the Bugbot pages, first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/.md offering, and independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs.
